craft_notes: Sthāyin: necessity's business. Rows: measure then mark. Read aloud: rule stamped.

lines: And Time, in the Act which he effects,
measures his making by that limit —
in the like, in every some, the making is just the same;
in this sense Fate's play is marked.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kālaś ca kāryaṃ kalayaṃs tadavacchinnaṃ kartṛtvam api kalayati tulye kvacittve asminn eva kartṛtvam ity atrārthe niyater vyāpāraḥ
